description: One cited evidence pack for an area: market depth (as get_market_depth), the latest recorded crime rate, road and rail noise shares, state schools within 1.5 km with their standing Ofsted grade, and, given an address_id inside the area, its building and street sale aggregates. Every block names its source release; not advice and not a valuation.
